additional_info.subject: RE: ID0367689-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001323] Contactor Issue CRM:00643000777
additional_info.body:
Hi Marnic,
Greetings of the day!
Regarding your issue with the contactors triggering the message, it doesn't seem to be a problem as of now. This error is self-explanatory and resolves itself. According to the logs, it occurs only for a few seconds before resolving. Currently, there is no issue with the contactors, and all the outlets are ready for charging. If there were an issue, the PLC error flags would be triggered, indicating that the coil is stuck, which would be permanently logged in the SCB. It does not seem to be causing any issues in the charging sessions. Only when a charging session is aborted does it give an 'Abnormal' error, which goes away automatically in a fraction of a second.
Please let us know if you have any further queries. If not, we shall close this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

Hi Marnic,
Regarding your issue, I again check the logs and it seems that the QA9-10 coils are stuck and if this Error flag is hampering the charging session then I would recommended it to replace the contactors. This is not the acceptable rate if only 1or 2 per day then it would be fine.
If you have no further questions, then I will handover the ticket to your queue for parts ordering & replacement.
Thank you.
With best regards,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0367689-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001323] Contactor Issue CRM:00643000777
additional_info.body:
Dear
But this are for me signs that the contactors are broken or will be broken in a few weeks. Waiting till it is broken so it will be interrupting charging sessions will lead to unhappy customers. This number of faults on this short period is not a good sign. For other chargers we don’t have this problem.
Br.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0367689-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001323] Contactor Issue CRM:00643000777
additional_info.body:
Marnic,
Yes, that is why we have AWS to check for particular errors over specific weeks or months. There might be chances that in the upcoming days, the contactor coils will get stuck, and then you can replace them. Please let me know if you want to replace them now or wait until the PLC error flag remains continuous in the SCB. I have shared the RMA form in the second ticket, and if the charger is from the Leipzig factory, then the shared form can be used. Kindly let me know if you have any further questions to discuss. If not, we shall hand over the ticket to your queue for replacement. Otherwise, we can close this ticket, and if the error becomes continuous on the SCB, you can create a new ticket for the same issue.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
